subject: Post-discovery: proposal to align ML/Infra technical immersion and roster
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novapulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: proposal to align ML/Infra technical immersion and roster

Alex — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we keep momentum: 

Key takeaways from discovery:
- Primary goal: move a production LLM workflow (inference + CI) into Novapulse infra within Q1.
- Main constraints: single-region deployment in us-west, strict data retention and audit requirements (SOC2 scope may apply), and predictable latency under 200ms P95.
- Probable workload profile: bursty inference at peak (150–300 RPS) with many short user sessions.

Recommended next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical immersion where our ML infra and runtime engineers walk through:
1) architecture fit (model variants, quantization options)
2) deployment topology for private/dedicated (VPC, KMS, networking)
3) perf expectations and latency/cost tradeoffs (batching, cache)
4) mutual action items & runbook for canary -> prod

Proposed windows (all PST):
- Tue 24 Nov, 10:00–11:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed 25 Nov, 09:00–10:30 or 15:00–16:30

Attachments: technical-immersion-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda + prep checklist), redwood-tdx-prep-checklist.docx (who to bring + pre-reads).

Ask: please confirm the window that works best and who on your side should join (SRE, infra, and security are typical). We’ll include our ML infra lead and a solutions engineer.

Thanks — I’ll hold the slots tentatively until I hear back.

—
Irene Choi
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Irene — thanks, this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed.

We can do the immersion next week. Best options for our key folks:
- Wed 25 Nov, 09:00–10:30 PST (preferred)
- Tue 24 Nov, 13:00–14:30 PST (backup)

Attendees from our side: myself (platform), Natalie Gomez (SRE lead), plus Jordan Li (security) — I’ve cc’d Natalie here.

Jordan will want a short pre-read on SOC2-data-flow and any KMS/HSM integration notes. Can you call out any sensitive docs you plan to share before we confirm? We need to route through our procurement/scc team for a quick intake form.

Appreciate you holding slots. If you can lock Wed 25 at 09:00 that works and I’ll confirm internally.
